scope: selected private Claude profile to native provider catalog

incidentEvidence.source: owned profile diagnostic journal and saved configuration metadata
incidentEvidence.userReported: Signed in after selection and refresh; Claude appeared as Usage Only

cause: Meridian selected-profile publication did not add the native Anthropic provider stanza, so the original Provider snapshot excluded Claude without an OpenCode integration connection. Requiring legacy plugin activation also incorrectly excluded the independently registered compiled provider owner when the saved legacy plugin list was empty.
change: The constructor reads private saved profile configuration metadata. An unambiguous CLI profile activates an empty Anthropic stanza only under the reviewed provider compatibility registration, independently of the legacy plugin list. Existing settings and provider exclusions survive. Meridian profiles/settings metadata participates in configuration capture retries.

original Provider snapshot and Model availability expose Claude in both locations
native Anthropic integration has zero credential connections
an unowned prepared request has zero physical observations and no Meridian attempt
admitted physical transport, failure and cancellation keep their original scope
